text: \jw “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom. \jw*
\jw Five of them were foolish, and five were wise. \jw*
\jw Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them, \jw*
\jw but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps. \jw*
\jw Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept. \jw*
\jw But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’ \jw*
\jw Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.\jw*
\jw The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’ \jw*
\jw But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’ \jw*
\jw While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut. \jw*
\jw Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’ \jw*
\jw But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’ \jw*
\jw Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.\jw*
\jw “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them. \jw*
\jw To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey. \jw*
\jw Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents. \jw*
\jw In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two. \jw*
\jw But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.\jw*
\jw “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them. \jw*
\jw He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’\jw*
\jw “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’\jw*
\jw “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’ \jw*
\jw “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’\jw*
\jw “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter. \jw*
\jw I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’\jw*
\jw “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter. \jw*
\jw You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest. \jw*
\jw Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents. \jw*
\jw For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away. \jw*
\jw Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’\jw*
\jw “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory. \jw*
\jw Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats. \jw*
\jw He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left. \jw*
\jw Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world; \jw*
\jw for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in. \jw*
\jw I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’\jw*
\jw “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink? \jw*
\jw When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you? \jw*
\jw When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’\jw*
\jw “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’ \jw*
\jw Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels; \jw*
\jw for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink; \jw*
\jw I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’\jw*
\jw “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’\jw*
\jw “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’ \jw*
\jw These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”\jw*
